$schema_note: Capability manifest for the connector-agnostic layer (Layer A2). KNOWN provider rows, keyed by provider tag. Detection is DETECT-ONCE-AT-DECLARATION (H-E): at declaration the agent inspects the declared server's tool list, writes the detected row into workspace config, user confirms; per-fire detection is only the never-declared fallback. Vocabularies are authored for mail + calendar ONLY (YAGNI — chat/storage/e-sign/accounting get keys when their first consumer skill exists). Fingerprints are the DISTINCTIVE tool-name subset used to re-pair a reconnected server (new UUID) to a known provider (A1b). Capability values are the provider's KNOWN default; a per-workspace detected row (from the actual connected server's tool list) overrides — e.g. M's Microsoft 365 is read-only, so its detected calendar row has event_crud=false even though outlook_calendar CAN do CRUD in general.

gmail.label: Gmail (native)
gmail.notes: Native Gmail in a UUID env exposes NO send tool and NO whoami (H-A). Send routes through the Zapier dispatch leg; from-alias addressing is unavailable — outbound from a specific account degrades to paste (N4).

superhuman.label: Superhuman
superhuman.notes: Fronts calendar too (create_or_update_event, get_availability). from-alias addressing supported (verified aliases). Sync lag ~1min after send (hole #9) — reconcile-sent must tolerate.

outlook.label: Microsoft 365 / Outlook
outlook.notes: M's connected M365 MCP is READ-ONLY (no draft/send/create — H-F). The Outlook WRITE path therefore ships to clients UNTESTED by construction; gate any Outlook-write claim. A write-capable Outlook connector would detect draft/send=true at declaration and override this row.

zapier_gmail.label: Zapier (Gmail send leg)
zapier_gmail.notes: The gmail-only dispatch leg (EMAIL_DRAFT_PROTOCOL §3c, H-D). MUST be pinned by server-id in workspace.connectors._zapier_server_ids, never matched as native Gmail (R12/H-H): its tool names contain 'gmail' but it is Zapier. Drafts are NEVER sent through Zapier. Only fires when the declared mail backend is Gmail.

google_calendar.label: Google Calendar (native)
google_calendar.notes: calendarId param = per-calendar/account routing (N4 supported). Native only, never Zapier (CONTRACT Rule 8).

outlook_calendar.label: Outlook Calendar (Graph)
outlook_calendar.notes: General Outlook Calendar row. On M's read-only M365 the detected row is availability/search only (event_crud=false) — detection overrides these defaults per connected server.

baseline.$note: Unknown-provider fallback (C4). At declaration an unrecognized server feature-detects into this shape (can it draft? send? create events?) rather than hard-failing. Absent booleans are treated as false (fail-closed).
